PLAN: With three solves left, adopt R909 (best 0.493) and test a modest root reflux reduction, the only remaining change with meaningful cost upside. Revert if blend recovery or purity declines; otherwise retain the best.

R909 uses TTT 40/3.0/0.7 and scores 0.493. Root boil-up changes are harmful; dp 0.3 is much worse. Root stages 45 are essentially tied with 50. Root duty is $260M, so a 5% reflux cut has more upside than further small-column tuning. TTT 0.6 fails C3 purity, 0.7 is optimal known, 0.8 slightly worse. Preserve TB and TT settings.
